summary: Brings one stereo pair of the audio device's input into the song as a source, with a Bypass switch. The pair and mono or stereo are chosen in its menu.
use_for: Bring the audio device's input into the song.
quirks: The input pair (0 to 31) and mono or stereo are machine state set from its menu, not parameters: param_set cannot change them.
It outputs nothing until a block of input has been captured, and with no input signal the profile heard silence, which is why its health is warn.
The capture is scaled to Buzz's sample range (x32768); in mono the left channel feeds both sides.
Whether a particular device channel arrives was not measured: unverified (the profile had no input).

problems: no sound from a MIDI note at its defaults (it has no Note track parameter)

parameters.name: Bypass
parameters.how: Switches the input off: no (the default) passes the audio device's input into the song, yes makes the machine output nothing.
parameters.sound: At no you hear the live input at its original level (watch for feedback with open speakers); at yes this source is silent.
